items.title: Can Apple’s incoming CEO bring back the product design mojo of the Steve Jobs era?
items.summary: With more than half of Apple’s revenue still tied to the iPhone, former insiders say Ternus must give designers more influence as the company searches for its next breakthrough.
items.titleZh: 苹果新任首席执行官能否重现史蒂夫·乔布斯时代的产品设计魔力？
items.summaryZh: 由于苹果公司一半以上的收入仍与iPhone有关，前内部人士表示，随着公司寻求下一个突破，Ternus必须给设计师更多的影响力。

items.title: Analysis: A powerful new coalition of AI skeptics is coalescing right in Trump's blind spot
items.summary: Evangelicals, labor unions and anti-AI-data-center activists are part of a groundswell worrying about how fast technology is changing.
items.titleZh: 分析：一个强大的人工智能怀疑论者新联盟正在特朗普的盲点中联合起来
items.summaryZh: 福音派、工会和反人工智能数据中心活动家是担心技术变化速度有多快的浪潮的一部分。

items.title: Logistics giants are racing to keep up with healthcare boom as GLP-1s highlight need for cold storage
items.summary: Shipping and logistics companies are tapping into the growing market of healthcare as cold chain and temperature-controlled facilities become more crucial.
items.titleZh: 物流巨头们正竞相跟上医疗保健热潮，因为GLP-1强调了冷藏的需求
items.summaryZh: 随着冷链和温控设施变得越来越重要，航运和物流公司正在进军不断增长的医疗保健市场。

items.title: I help billionaires buy private jets. Sometimes I tell them not to.
items.summary: Mike Francis, the head of aviation finance at Citi, has a rule of thumb about when to buy a private jet.
items.titleZh: 我帮助亿万富翁购买私人飞机。有时我告诉他们不要。
items.summaryZh: 花旗银行航空金融主管迈克·弗朗西斯（Mike Francis）对何时购买私人飞机有一个经验法则。

items.title: 'The Great Inversion': Why one innovation theorist says technology is no longer adapting to us — we're adapting to it
items.summary: AI isn't just changing the world around us, innovation theorist John Nosta says. It's changing how humans adapt, think, and solve problems.
items.titleZh: “大反转”：为什么一位创新理论家说技术不再适应我们——我们正在适应它
items.summaryZh: 创新理论家约翰·诺斯塔说，人工智能不仅改变了我们周围的世界。它正在改变人类适应、思考和解决问题的方式。

items.title: I've worked as a software engineer for 14 years. AI could cut junior jobs — but not the need for experienced engineers.
items.summary: A software engineer says AI could reduce junior engineering jobs, but experienced engineers who adapt will still be needed.
items.titleZh: 我做了14年的软件工程师。人工智能可以削减初级职位，但不需要经验丰富的工程师。
items.summaryZh: 一位软件工程师表示，人工智能可以减少初级工程工作，但仍需要经验丰富的工程师来适应。

items.title: I sold my startup for millions without a single dollar in revenue. Here’s why that’s the point
items.summary: It was Thomson Reuters’ first pre-revenue acquisition in 174 years, and one of the more significant European deals of 2024, but that wasn't the surprise.
items.titleZh: 我以数百万美元的价格卖掉了我的初创公司，却没有一美元的收入。这就是为什么这是重点
items.summaryZh: 这是汤森路透174年来的首次营收前收购，也是2024年欧洲最重要的交易之一，但这并不奇怪。
